# `vowp` CLI reference

Status: current

<!-- generated by docs/reference/generate.py; do not edit -->

This page is the complete `--help` tree of the `vowp` binary, committed as text. The command
surface is `V0_1_COMMANDS` plus `V0_2_COMMANDS` in
[`crates/vowp-cli/src/cli.rs`](../../crates/vowp-cli/src/cli.rs); the behaviour of each command is
specified in [`docs/design/cli.md`](../design/cli.md). Hidden commands are included because they
are part of the binary even when `vowp --help` does not advertise them.

Regenerate after a CLI change:

```sh
cargo build -p vowp-cli --bin vowp
python3 docs/reference/generate.py
python3 docs/reference/check-reference.py
```

## `vowp`

```text
VOWP: local-first supervisor for AI coding agents

Usage: vowp [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init          Initialise this git repository as a VOWP project
  doctor        Check the node, database, harnesses and providers
  up            Create the tmux layout and start the supervisor
  down          Stop the supervisor
  status        Show the supervisor, jobs, slots, limits, cost and inbox
  board         Print or refresh the board
  plan          Start a planner turn for a goal
  job           Add, inspect or change jobs
  graph         Print, export or import the job graph
  attach        Attach to a job's tmux window
  session       List and operate universal sessions
  chat          Alias of `session chat`
  inbox         List and answer inbox items
  cost          Show cost totals
  node          Add, list or remove nodes
  loops         List or pause supervisor loops
  schedule      Manage scheduled actions
  promote       Promote a change to an environment
  rollback      Roll a release back
  releases      List releases
  reindex       Rebuild the session index from JSONL logs
  backup        Back up the node database
  schema        Print one exported JSON Schema
  project       Register, list, pause or archive projects
  fleet         Read the node snapshot, queue and inbox
  capacity      Show or change measured capacity
  secret        Set, list, remove or request secrets
  gc            List lifecycle classes and collect garbage
  tunnel        Open, list or close control-machine SSH tunnels
  setup         Plan or apply the AI-first setup
  control       Configure this machine as the control machine
  orchestrator  Create and manage orchestrator sessions
  migrate       Migrate a v0.1 home to the v0.2 layout
  mcp           Run the stdio MCP server
  version       Print the binary version

Options:
      --json                 Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout
      --node <NAME>          Run the command on that node over ssh
      --project <NAME|PATH>  Project name or path; defaults to the nearest ancestor with `vowp.toml`
      --home <DIR>           Node home (default `$VOWP_HOME`, else `~/.vowp`)
      --no-color             Disable colour even when stdout is a terminal
  -q, --quiet                Suppress non-essential human output
  -v, --verbose...           Increase log verbosity (`-v`, `-vv`)
  -h, --help                 Print help
  -V, --version              Print version
```

### `vowp init`

```text
Initialise this git repository as a VOWP project

Usage: vowp init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json                 Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout
      --name <NAME>          Project name slug; defaults to the repository directory name
      --force                Overwrite an existing project and existing framework files
      --node <NAME>          Run the command on that node over ssh
      --no-framework         Do not install the embedded framework files
      --project <NAME|PATH>  Project name or path; defaults to the nearest ancestor with `vowp.toml`
      --home <DIR>           Node home (default `$VOWP_HOME`, else `~/.vowp`)
      --no-color             Disable colour even when stdout is a terminal
  -q, --quiet                Suppress non-essential human output
  -v, --verbose...           Increase log verbosity (`-v`, `-vv`)
  -h, --help                 Print help
```

### `vowp up`

```text
Create the tmux layout and start the supervisor

Usage: vowp up [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --foreground           Run the supervisor loop in this process
      --json                 Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout
      --detach               Explicitly detach (the default)
      --node <NAME>          Run the command on that node over ssh
      --no-tmux              Do not create the tmux windows
      --project <NAME|PATH>  Project name or path; defaults to the nearest ancestor with `vowp.toml`
      --home <DIR>           Node home (default `$VOWP_HOME`, else `~/.vowp`)
      --no-migrate           Do not migrate the home before starting the supervisor
      --no-color             Disable colour even when stdout is a terminal
      --once                 Run exactly one supervisor tick and exit
  -q, --quiet                Suppress non-essential human output
  -v, --verbose...           Increase log verbosity (`-v`, `-vv`)
  -h, --help                 Print help
```

#### `vowp job add`

```text
Add one job and its brief

Usage: vowp job add [OPTIONS] --id <SLUG> --title <TEXT> --kind <KIND>

Options:
      --id <SLUG>              Job id slug
      --json                   Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout
      --node <NAME>            Run the command on that node over ssh
      --title <TEXT>           Human-readable title
      --kind <KIND>            Job kind (`build`, `verify`, `plan`, ...)
      --project <NAME|PATH>    Project name or path; defaults to the nearest ancestor with `vowp.toml`
      --home <DIR>             Node home (default `$VOWP_HOME`, else `~/.vowp`)
      --role <ROLE>            Role; defaults from the kind
      --no-color               Disable colour even when stdout is a terminal
      --profile <NAME>         Profile; defaults to the role name
      --needs <A,B>            Jobs that must finish first
  -q, --quiet                  Suppress non-essential human output
      --owns <GLOB,...>        Ownership globs
  -v, --verbose...             Increase log verbosity (`-v`, `-vv`)
      --reads <GLOB,...>       Read globs
      --gates <SET|SHORT,...>  Gate set names or short gate forms
      --priority <N>           Dispatch priority (higher first)
      --max-attempts <N>       Maximum fix rounds
      --brief-file <PATH>      Read the brief body from this file
      --brief <PATH|->         Read the brief body from stdin (`-`)
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

```text
  probe  Check that the helper context and vault directory are usable
  set    Read one value from stdin and write it as the vault user
  rm     Remove one secret as the vault user

Options:
      --json                 Print one machine-readable JSON document on stdout
      --node <NAME>          Run the command on that node over ssh
      --project <NAME|PATH>  Project name or path; defaults to the nearest ancestor with `vowp.toml`
      --home <DIR>           Node home (default `$VOWP_HOME`, else `~/.vowp`)
      --no-color             Disable colour even when stdout is a terminal
  -q, --quiet                Suppress non-essential human output
  -v, --verbose...           Increase log verbosity (`-v`, `-vv`)
  -h, --help                 Print help
```
